DISCHARGE SUMMARY - CELLULAR THERAPY
Admission: 2036-06-28    Discharge: 2036-07-11
Diagnosis: relapsed large B-cell lymphoma; autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T infusion 2036-06-29.
HOSPITAL COURSE:
1. CRS grade 1 on Day +2 (fever without hypotension or hypoxia); one dose of tocilizumab; afebrile from Day +3.
2. Neurotoxicity: ICE fell to 8/10 on 2036-07-03 and remained 8/10 on 2036-07-04. CT head unremarkable. Treated with dexamethasone, tapered over 5 days. ICE 10/10 on 2036-07-06.
3. Neutropenia: G-CSF not required; ANC recovering at discharge.
DISCHARGE EXAM: alert, oriented, no focal deficits.
FOLLOW-UP: clinic in 1 week; no driving for 8 weeks after infusion.
